verdict_evidence: Selection uses three different choosers (LLM tool schemas + classical ChatActionMapper + predeclared workflow config.action). Shared: catalog_write_authority for write classification; invoke_tool for connector execution. Not shared: one call-time catalog selector or one pre-invoke input-schema validator across all paths.

paths.input_schemas_validated_before_invoke: YES for staged writes via ActionWorkflowSchema; not generic jsonschema on every invoke
paths.allowlist: connector_execution_matrix + ToolRegistry; classical ChatActionMapper is a second selector
drift_risks: LLM tool_choice vs ChatActionMapper can disagree
Tool narrowing can omit the correct catalog action

paths.selection_constrained_to_catalog_at_call: YES for connected+permitted+narrowed ToolRegistry tools; MCP is an extra non-catalog set
paths.input_schemas_validated_before_invoke: NO central schema validate — executor-level ToolValidationError; writes redirected to chat approval staging
paths.allowlist: ToolRegistry + agent permitted_tools + MCP org tools
drift_risks: assistant_*/mcp_* exemptions outside catalog write authority

paths.selection_constrained_to_catalog_at_call: NO LLM selection — author-time config.action; membership via list_registered_actions() (executor registry), not chat matrix
paths.input_schemas_validated_before_invoke: NO validate_connector_plan in handlers; binding validator + executor checks only
drift_risks: Executor keys can diverge from chat-exposed matrix rows
Canvas write gate shares catalog_write_authority but not chat param schema staging

drift_risks_global: Three choosers: LLM tool schemas, ChatActionMapper scores, workflow config.action
Two schema layers: parameters_for_action (OpenAI) vs ActionWorkflowSchema (chat write staging)
Two membership sets: list_registered_actions vs connector_execution_matrix chat-executable
Write authority is shared; action selection is not
recommendation: Defer unification to a later slice; do not claim ONE_MECHANISM until classical mapper and workflow bind share one call-time selector + schema gate.
